script: In 1943, British intelligence needed the Nazis to believe an invasion was coming somewhere it wasn't. Their plan was almost too strange to believe. They took the body of a dead homeless man, dressed him as a Royal Marine officer, and handcuffed a briefcase to his wrist full of fake invasion plans. Then they dropped him from a submarine off the coast of Spain, letting the current carry him ashore. Spanish authorities found the body and quietly passed the documents to German spies. Hitler believed every word. He rushed his troops away from Sicily to defend Greece instead. When the real invasion hit Sicily, it faced almost no resistance. A dead man fooled the Nazi high command.
